panels.gesture: A welcoming, magnetic warm smile; one open hand raised near the chest, palm gently facing the visitor, relaxed shoulders.
An appreciative soft smile and warm attentive eyes; slight head incline, one open palm indicating the unseen person courteously, the other hand at his own chest.
A playful knowing wink and asymmetric smile; fingertips lightly resting at his bearded chin, easy confident posture.
A conspiratorial mischievous grin, eyes looking sideways; one cupped hand beside the mouth and a slight forward lean, never obscuring his face.
A hearty attractive laugh with smiling narrowed eyes; shoulders relaxed, one hand resting against the lower ribs and the other loosely opened outward.
An elegant inviting smile; one forearm sweeping gently outward to offer passage or an invitation to dance, open upward-facing palm, no partner shown.
A sincere appreciative smile, small respectful inclination of the head; one flat hand over the heart, the other arm relaxed.
One eyebrow raised and a teasing confident smile; a relaxed hand makes a subtle beckoning gesture with naturally curled fingers, no rude gesture.
An unusually tender earnest gaze and gentle closed-mouth smile; both hands extended slightly toward the unseen listener, palms open in a caring, reassuring offer.
